Raw comic: https://e-hentai.org/g/3512262/4a4301c1b3/

Firstly, I apologize if I got any of the lore,character speaking styles, military terms they use etc. wrong. I've never played the kancolle games, but I did do research on the kancolle world for this comic.
Feel free to let me know if I translated anything wrong and what the correct translation would be, as well as if i got any of the lore, names wrong. Always trying to improve with each translation I do.

To explain what the "dam" series is, basically this author has done 4 other comics for this "dam" series featuring Akebono, Tatsuta, Kumano, and Murakumo. Each of the titles mention how their "dam" is either full, going to burst, etc. This is the final comic of that series. The story does reference some moments from the other stories, so check those out if you want the full details on what happened before this story. I'll link the other stories below

Akebono's part: https://www.omorashi.org/gallery/album/2095-eng-kohri_ms-akebono-needs-to-release-her-dam/
Murakumo's part: https://e-hentai.org/g/2839867/1a1ffb7c28/
Kumano's part:https://e-hentai.org/g/2839827/fb512916bf/
Tatsuta's part: https://e-hentai.org/g/2825480/b6d368a22d/

There's apparently 2 more parts to this story to be released in the future. I plan to translate those as well If I see them on this site.
